ticker_news.title: TCS, AMD Partner To Accelerate Enterprise AI Adoption At Scale
ticker_news.description: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announced a strategic partnership to help enterprises scale AI initiatives from pilot to production. The collaboration will co-develop industry-specific AI solutions for life sciences, manufacturing, and BFSI sectors, combining TCS's integration expertise with AMD's computing and AI portfolio. TCS will integrate AMD Ryzen CPUs, EPYC CPUs, Instinct GPUs, and AI accelerators across hybrid cloud and edge environments.
ticker_news.author: Anusuya Lahiri

ticker_news.title: Prediction: This AI Hardware Stock Could Become One of the Next $1 Trillion Companies
ticker_news.description: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) could reach $1 trillion market cap in under four years, driven by 60% CAGR growth in its data center division. AMD's cheaper GPU alternatives to Nvidia, improved ROCm software (10x download increase), and Nvidia's supply constraints position AMD to capture AI market share. With an expected overall 35% CAGR across all divisions, AMD could triple in value within three years.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

ticker_news.title: Should You Buy Micron Before 2027?
ticker_news.description: Micron Technology is positioned as an attractive investment opportunity due to its dominance in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) production, with only three companies globally capable of producing HBM at scale. The company has experienced significant growth with revenue up 56% year-over-year to $13.6 billion and trades at a forward P/E of 11, well below the tech industry average of 26. With exponential demand growth expected for HBM over the next decade and limited competition, Micron's stock has surged nearly 250% in the past 12 months.
ticker_news.author: Catie Hogan

ticker_news.title: NVIDIA's Next Chip Isn't Just Faster -- It Could Make AI 10 Times Cheaper to Run
ticker_news.description: NVIDIA unveiled its Rubin platform at CES 2026, featuring new Vera CPUs and Rubin GPUs that can reduce AI inference token costs by up to 90% compared to the Blackwell platform. The significant cost reduction addresses a critical challenge for enterprises, as 95% of AI pilots currently fail to deliver meaningful financial impact. Major cloud providers including CoreWeave, Microsoft, Alphabet, and AWS are expected to deploy Rubin in 2026, potentially driving increased AI adoption and chip demand.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Green

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100 Futures Tumble Ahead Of SC Ruling On Trump's Tariffs— Wells Fargo, BP, WeRide In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Wednesday as investors await a Supreme Court ruling on Trump's tariff authority. The Consumer Price Index rose 2.7% year-over-year in December, matching expectations, while core CPI came in slightly below forecasts at 2.6%. Major indices including the Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq 100 all declined in premarket trading. Notable movers include Wells Fargo reporting earnings, BP announcing a $5 billion writedown in energy transition businesses, WeRide launching a robotaxi service on WeChat, and TG Therapeutics providing optimistic 2026 guidance.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
